//: The browser journeys (T103): Playwright driving the production build against emulators seeded with fixtures. Its own package so Playwright and firebase-admin stay out of the app's install. Run it with `npm --prefix firebase run test:e2e`, which starts the emulators it needs (firebase.e2e.json) and stops them after; see CLAUDE.md. @playwright/test is pinned exactly: its version decides which browser build `playwright install` fetches, and CI caches that by this file's lockfile.
